network_error: No connection. Your work is saved and will send when you're back online.
server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
conflict: This was changed elsewhere. Review the latest version.
idempotency_mismatch: This action was already sent with different details. Please start it again.
invalid_credentials: Phone number or password is incorrect.
otp_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
phone_invalid: Enter a valid Nigerian phone number.
phone_taken: An account already exists for this phone number. Sign in instead.
account_suspended: This account is suspended. Contact WHY ME support.
app_update_required: Please update WHY ME to continue.
capability_required: Turn on selling or services for your account first.
listing_limit_reached: You have reached the number of active listings on your plan. Pause one, or upgrade.
content_blocked: Remove phone numbers, account numbers, emails and links. Buyers contact you through WHY ME.
invalid_transition: This changed meanwhile. Refresh to see its current status.
listing_incomplete: Please complete the highlighted fields before publishing.
terms_required: Please accept the current seller terms to continue.
profile_incomplete: Tell buyers a little more about yourself (at least 20 characters) before publishing.
too_many_photos: You can add up to {{limit}} photos here on your plan.
upload_invalid: One of these photos can no longer be used. Remove it and add it again.
photo_rejected: One of your photos couldn't be read. Replace it with another photo.
photos_processing: Your photos are still being prepared. We will try again shortly.
sms_unavailable: We couldn't send the SMS just now. Please try again in a minute.
email_otp_disabled: Getting the code by email is switched off at the moment. Use SMS instead.
email_unavailable: We couldn't send the email just now. Please try again in a minute.
email_taken: This email already belongs to a WHY ME account. Sign in instead.
phone_unverified: Confirm your phone number to continue. We will text you a code.
phone_already_verified: Your phone number is already confirmed.
registration_expired: Your confirmed code has expired. Please ask for a new code.
in_review: A moderator is checking this. You can make changes once the review is done.
conversation_closed: WHY ME closed this conversation, so no new messages can be sent.
idempotency_key_invalid: The request ID is not valid.
request_in_progress: This action is already being processed. Please wait.
cannot_message_yourself: This is your own listing or page.
checkout_unavailable: Protected checkout isn't open yet. You can message the seller in the meantime.
listing_unavailable: This item is no longer for sale.
not_buyable: This can't be bought directly. Message the seller, or request the service.
fulfilment_not_offered: The seller doesn't offer that. Choose another option.
not_enough_stock: Not enough left. Lower the quantity.
payment_gateway_unavailable: We couldn't reach the payment service. No money was taken. Please try again in a minute.
dispute_not_allowed: A problem can be reported only on a paid order whose money WHY ME still holds.
dispute_open: You reported a problem on this order. Withdraw the report first if everything is fine now.
dispute_closed: This report is closed, so nothing more can be added.
dispute_amount_invalid: The amount must be more than ₦0 and no more than the order total.
dispute_refund_invalid: A partial refund must be more than ₦0 and less than the order total.
refund_not_allowed: This payment can't be refunded now: WHY ME no longer holds the money for it.
refund_amount_invalid: The refund must be more than ₦0 and no more than what is left on the payment.
release_blocked: This order's money can't be released yet. See the checks.
payout_exists: A release for this order already exists.
second_approver_required: Someone other than the first approver must give the second approval.
bank_unknown: Choose your bank from the list.
bank_account_not_found: The bank couldn't find that account number. Check the number and the bank.
invalid_outcome: That outcome doesn't fit this order's current status.
bank_lookup_unavailable: We couldn't check the account with the bank just now. Please try again in a little while.
